info.name: Student ID - Applicant Service
info.description: Applicant merged Lab 3 source (0.4.0): run in order through Gateway http://localhost:8090 with a valid accessToken in a private local environment. Tracked tokens stay empty. Generates disposable student IDs, verifies CRUD, duplicate create/update 409 and rollback, sanitized 400/404 errors, 405 and cleanup. Record membership headers use a local mock, not live Session authorization. Internal /status, concurrent races, database faults, image provenance and full shared-stack acceptance are separate checks. Existing CPR image pins may predate these source changes. Lab 4 Task 3: the custom Python Message Broker is a repository scaffold with no runtime API or routing integration yet. The Gateway boundary folder checks this service's existing health relay and rejects missing or malformed authorization. Existing business requests and their contracts are unchanged.

variable.description: Supply a valid Gateway test JWT in a private environment; never commit tokens or signing keys.

item.name: Lab 4 Task 3 - Gateway boundary
item.description: Run these existing Gateway checks before the business requests below. Keep baseUrl pointed at Gateway, not a backend or the new broker. The custom Python broker currently has no listener, published image, endpoint or queue contract to call.

request.description: Public Gateway relay for this service's existing health/readiness endpoint. Requires a running, healthy service and its database; this does not probe the custom broker.

exec: pm.test('Owned service health: HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Owned service reports UP', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('UP'));

request.description: Explicit No Auth overrides the collection bearer token. Gateway must reject this request before forwarding it to the owned service.

exec: pm.test('Gateway rejects unauthorized access: HTTP 401', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

pm.test('Gateway uses the existing authentication error contract', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('UNAUTHENTICATED'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('gateway-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer'); });

pm.test('Authentication error matches the response trace ID', () => { const traceId = pm.response.headers.get('X-Trace-Id'); pm.expect(traceId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.traceId).to.eql(traceId); });

request.description: No Auth disables inherited authorization; the deliberately incomplete Bearer header contains no token. Gateway must return its existing 401 error.

exec: pm.test('Gateway rejects unauthorized access: HTTP 401', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

pm.test('Gateway uses the existing authentication error contract', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('UNAUTHENTICATED'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('gateway-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer'); });

pm.test('Authentication error matches the response trace ID', () => { const traceId = pm.response.headers.get('X-Trace-Id'); pm.expect(traceId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.traceId).to.eql(traceId); });
pm.collectionVariables.unset('applicantId'); pm.collectionVariables.unset('applicantConflictId');
const value = 'postman-applicant-' + pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}');
pm.collectionVariables.set('applicantStudentId', value); pm.collectionVariables.set('applicantOtherStudentId', value + '-other');
pm.test('Create disposable applicant: HTTP 201', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

pm.test('Created disposable record matches input', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.id).to.match(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i); pm.expect(body.studentId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('applicantStudentId')); pm.collectionVariables.set('applicantId', body.id); });
pm.test('List includes created record: HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Created ID is listed', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.some(row => row.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('applicantId'))).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Get by ID: HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Stored student ID matches', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().studentId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('applicantStudentId')));
pm.test('Duplicate create is a conflict: HTTP 409', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));

pm.test('Sanitized STUDENT_ID_CONFLICT error', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('STUDENT_ID_CONFLICT'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('applicant-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('applicantStudentId')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('Detail: Key'); });
pm.test('Create disposable conflict target: HTTP 201', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

pm.test('Created disposable record matches input', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.id).to.match(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i); pm.expect(body.studentId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('applicantOtherStudentId')); pm.collectionVariables.set('applicantConflictId', body.id); });
pm.test('Duplicate update is a conflict: HTTP 409', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));

pm.test('Sanitized STUDENT_ID_CONFLICT error', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('STUDENT_ID_CONFLICT'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('applicant-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('applicantStudentId')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('Detail: Key'); });
pm.test('Conflict rollback preserves target: HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Conflicting update did not change student ID', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().studentId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('applicantOtherStudentId')));
pm.test('Update original record: HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Updated name persisted', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().name).to.eql('Postman Applicant Updated'));
pm.test('Get updated record: HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Read observes update', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().name).to.eql('Postman Applicant Updated'));
pm.test('Invalid input is rejected: HTTP 400', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test('Malformed JSON is rejected: HTTP 400', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));

pm.test('Sanitized INVALID_REQUEST error', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('INVALID_REQUEST'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('applicant-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('applicantStudentId')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('Detail: Key'); });
pm.test('Missing record returns 404: HTTP 404', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

pm.test('Sanitized APPLICANT_NOT_FOUND error', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('APPLICANT_NOT_FOUND'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('applicant-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('applicantStudentId')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('Detail: Key'); });
pm.test('Unsupported method returns 405: HTTP 405', () => pm.response.to.have.status(405));
pm.test('Delete conflict target: HTTP 204', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));
pm.test('Delete original record: HTTP 204', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));
pm.test('Get deleted record returns 404: HTTP 404', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

pm.test('Sanitized APPLICANT_NOT_FOUND error', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('APPLICANT_NOT_FOUND'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('applicant-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('applicantStudentId')); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('Detail: Key'); });
